data.description:
Welcome to UltraCity, where the neon-lit streets pulse with the rhythm of cybernetic life. Immerse yourself in **the heart of a cyberpunk metropolis** as one of the elite Operators, capable of projecting your consciousness into **a team of skilled heroes** known as the NEON Squad.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031334_409258475508039_8965680661115487468_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=oHK8O8MB1DUQ7kNvgF3AVwz&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDQ7I5vEC5eFSVYGkkoeU_dDNJ6g0G-PCL7aiBCY4QGlg&oe=6745BCAF)

Gather **your friends or online allies** and navigate the vibrant, wacky world from the comfort of a virtual bar. A captivating **holographic table** serves as your interface to key locations in the city and beyond. You'll undertake **daring missions** on behalf of the **powerful corporations**, all under the guidance of an enigmatic Handler.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003272_521721420250791_1749029299216790958_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=oA-qOphWaJAQ7kNvgFRr5rY&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBhLnhxORYQsJtDxJ1kGvlreNty5QpBVV6wg2hTFn6Ozg&oe=67459A69)

But success demands more than just brute force. As you navigate the dangerous streets, underworld, and irradiated badlands, **strategic thinking** and **clever teamwork** will be your greatest assets. Coordinate your squad's actions in **thrilling turn-based tactical battles**, where every decision could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39035389_531689589532044_676684193823177442_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NHlV9ZF6ABgQ7kNvgGm0bwj&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDyidl_wMzT3yJRzUPCYhgay3_MZ8J-ggjtn2OZ-k_mzg&oe=67459F8C)

Pre-mission planning is crucial. **Wager wisely** to secure valuable resources and credits, essential for **recruiting new squad members** and **crafting advanced weaponry and cybernetic enhancements**. Choose your team carefully, each member bringing unique skills and abilities to the table. **Customize your squad members** to suit your playstyle!

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75258663_1026413825701774_4822464484390551879_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=q-5O16rMkc8Q7kNvgFzZNrr&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCg-Tn4aOd_dbWgzUct1we_NENeyti7V_pk5sLxS53NcQ&oe=674593D5)

**Forge alliances, outsmart your enemies, and rise to the top of the cybernetic food chain**. Are you ready to become a legend in the AGDA 2024 nominated NEON Squad Tactics?

![{"height":500,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982660_890964689556631_4106676401776551012_n.png?_nc_cat=109&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=tlavYFYDbVkQ7kNvgG_E_dy&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCdfkHSJdYyfXu6fj7muTotOxaqPXlpDAq-5dLzCwbGdg&oe=6745C180)
